jobs.occupation: Mechanical Engineer  From CAD Clean-up to Next-Generation Boat Design
jobs.description: Mechanical Engineer“Make X Shore’s CAD data something production can build from without guessing. Audit and rebuild assemblies, align them with the factory floor, and then help design the next-generation boat.”About the RoleX Shore’s existing CAD models and assemblies don’t fully reflect what’s actually being built on the factory floor — data has drifted from production reality, making it hard to trust drawings, plan rework, or hand off clean information to manufacturing. We’re looking for a Mechanical Engineer to audit and rebuild that CAD data, get it aligned with how boats are actually produced, and then move on to design work on X Shore’s next-generation boat platform.This is a hands-on role in two phases. First, you’ll dig into existing CAD, correct what’s out of sync with production, and work closely with the shop floor to close the gap between design intent and built reality. Once that foundation is solid, you’ll shift into forward-looking platform design for future boats. You’ll report to the Mechanical Engineering & Analysis Manager and be based on-site in Nyköping.Key Responsibilities    Audit existing CAD models and assemblies for accuracy, completeness, and structure    Rebuild or correct CAD data that no longer reflects what’s actually being built in production    Align CAD assemblies and drawings with current production reality, working directly with the shop floor    Identify and resolve discrepancies between design intent and manufactured parts    Maintain clean, well-structured CAD/PDM practices going forward    Support production with drawings, tolerances, and design clarifications during rework and manufacturing    Once alignment work is complete, contribute to the design and detailing of X Shore’s next-generation boat platform    Collaborate with electrical, production, and manufacturing engineering teams to ensure designs are manufacturableRequired Qualifications    Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent practical experience    3-5+ years of experience in mechanical design, ideally in a manufacturing environment    Expert-level SOLIDWORKS proficiency — this is a must-have, including assemblies, drawings, and PDM    Demonstrated experience auditing, cleaning up, or rebuilding CAD data and assemblies    Comfortable working directly with production to resolve build discrepancies    Fluent in English; Swedish is a plus    Ability to work on-site in NyköpingDesirable Qualifications    Experience with composites and/or metals typical of marine or automotive manufacturing    Background in boat building, automotive, or another complex hardware environment    Familiarity with GD&T and tolerance stack-up analysis    Experience contributing to a new product platform from early concept through releasePersonal QualitiesDetail-oriented and methodical, comfortable untangling messy legacy data without losing momentum. Equally at home on the shop floor verifying fit as at a CAD workstation. jobs.occupation: Senior Product Manager - Stockholm or Hudiksvall
jobs.description: Want to tackle complex customer problems, shape product strategy, and turn insight into measurable impact? Come and join us as a Senior Product Manager.About the RoleWe’re looking for a Senior Product Manager who combines strategic thinking with hands-on product leadership. You’ll shape the vision and strategy for your product area and turn customer insights into measurable customer and business outcomes. You’ll lead your Product Trio and the work of your empowered cross-functional team through expertise, influence, and collaboration, without formal people-management responsibilities.What You’ll DoProduct Leadership    Set the vision and strategy for your product area.    Lead discovery and delivery with your Product Trio and cross functional team.    Use customer insights and data to define impactful solutions.    Set success metrics and ensure measurable outcomes.    Align stakeholders across commercial, technical, and customer-facing teams.    Lead through influence and champion modern product practices.You’ll often lead your team remotely rather than work together in person day to day, making strong communication and trust-building essential.Who You AreTo succeed in this role, you bring strategic thinking, strong collaboration skills, and a natural drive to move things forward. We place more weight on your personal qualities than on having the “perfect” resume.You are:    A strong collaborator who builds trust and brings people together.    Confident in making decisions, even in complex situations.    Proactive and self‑driven, with a strong sense of ownership.    Strategic, analytical, and able to prioritise what matters most.    Goal- and results-oriented with the energy to drive progress.    A supportive, inclusive leader who develops and coaches others.    Guided by integrity and empathy, fostering a positive and safe environment.What You BringWe believe the right mindset and personal qualities matter most. But to thrive, you likely have:    Experience as a Product Manager working with modern product development.    Curiosity and drive. You make things happen rather than wait for direction.    Strong communication skills in English; Swedish is an advantage.    Experience with SaaS, the Product Operating Model, or Agile frameworks is a plus.    Experience working with AI coding assistants and context repositories is a plus.Who We AreWe are Bjorn Lunden, the business platform that simplifies everyday life for small and medium-sized businesses. Our belief is simple: every business deserves opportunities to grow, and we’re here to make that happen 🐻.We’re on an exciting journey. With bold ambitions, our vision is to become one of the leading providers of accounting and financial software solutions in Northwestern Europe. With our roots in Hälsingland, specifically in the small village of Näsviken, we’ve grown rapidly in recent years, transforming from a smaller national company into an international group. Today, we operate in Sweden, the Netherlands, and Denmark.Our goal is straightforward: to make life a little easier for entrepreneurs and business owners. We believe we can do that through great software, knowledge, innovation, and TACO. Not the kind you might be thinking of - but our version: Trust, Ambition, Collaboration, and Ownership.What We OfferWe offer you a role in an international, growing company with a strong market position and the ambition to challenge industry giants. The wellbeing of our employees truly matters to us, and we want to be a fair and responsible employer where people feel good and enjoy their work.We strive for a healthy work-life balance and support this through competitive conditions and benefits and flexible work opportunities. We want to be the natural first choice for people who want to thrive and have fun at work.ApplicationThis is a full-time, permanent position based in Stockholm or Hudiksvall. Application deadline is 13th December 2026, but selection and interviews may take place on an ongoing basis. The position may therefore be filled before the deadline, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.For questions, feel free to contact: Johan Lindahl, Head of Product Management johan.lindahl@bjornlunden.com *For this recruitment, we kindly ask that recruitment agencies or other external partners refrain from contacting us.

jobs.occupation: Senior Enterprise Account Executive – New Logo Sales
jobs.description: Tacton is looking for a Senior Account Executive who loves the hunt. In this net-new logo role, you'll own a territory of named enterprise manufacturers across Europe, open doors at companies new to Tacton, and close deals that help them make every customer promise one their factory can keep. You'll lead multi-stakeholder sales cycles of 6–12+ months, from first outreach to signature, engaging executives across sales, engineering, operations, and IT. Sales Engineering, Professional Services, Customer Success, and Marketing will support you, but the pipeline, deal strategy, and close are yours. You'll report to our SVP EMEA in a performance-driven sales organization with clear goals and transparent metrics. What you'll do  Hunt for new logos: Build pipeline across named target accounts together with your Business Development Manager  Open executive doors: Build trusted relationships with the C-suite, economic buyers, and champions across business and IT  Lead discovery and value mapping: Uncover challenges, quantify impact, and build the business case using the Tacton Sales Process  Run complex deal cycles: Keep multi-threaded opportunities moving and stakeholders aligned  Quarterback the team: Bring in Sales Engineering, Professional Services, and leadership at the right moments  Stay close to your market: Keep a steady cadence of calls, meetings, site visits, demos, and events  Negotiate and close: Lead commercial and legal negotiations to signature  Exceed your number: Consistently exceed your new-business quota Requirements  7+ years of enterprise software sales, with a proven record of winning new logos across multiple multi-year tenures  Consistent quota attainment, closing six- and seven-figure deals  Experience selling mission-critical enterprise systems (e.g., ERP, PLM, CRM, supply chain, or industrial software). Manufacturing experience is a strong plus; CPQ is a plus, not a requirement  Experience selling to executive buying committees  Daily hands-on use of AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot) to research prospects, prepare for meetings, and manage your pipeline  Experience from fast-growth, private equity-backed companies is preferred  Fluent English; German, French, or a Scandinavian language is a strong plus Who you are  A hunter at heart: Prospecting isn't a chore, it's how you win  Resilient: You hear "no" and keep going  A proven closer: You create urgency, navigate procurement, and get deals signed  Driven by the numbers: You own your metrics and see KPIs as tools to win  A value storyteller: You sell business outcomes, not features, to CFOs and VPs of Engineering alike  In it for the long game: You build pipeline that pays off in year two and beyond, and you've done it more than once  Present with customers: You build trust in person through site visits, workshops, and plant tours  A coachable team player: You take direction, share what works, and win with your team  Transparent: You believe in honesty and openness Recruitment process 1. Screening call with Talent Acquisition 2. Interview with the hiring manager 3. Personality and logical ability test 4. Second interview and peer meeting, including a case study or value pitch 5. Interview with senior management 6. Reference and background checks Why Tacton? Grow your career in a global, open organization that values teamwork and uses the latest technology to solve complex challenges in manufacturing.  33 days of paid time off (30 vacation days + 3 extra)  Premium occupational pension beyond ITP1  5,000 SEK annual wellness allowance  Private healthcare insurance  Parental leave top-up to 90% of base salary for up to 6 months  Weekly fika or breakfast * Hybrid setup: 3 days a week in the office Promise what you can build. Build what you promised. For 26 years, Tacton has helped manufacturers of complex products do exactly that. Through Tacton's Connected Suite, every configuration flows on one digital thread from product definition to the factory floor, and AI agents can promise only what can actually be built. Learn more at www.tacton.com

Company description:Ericsson ABJob description:   Join our Team   About this opportunitySPP is Ericsson’s internal management consultancy. We work closely with Ericsson’s Executive Team to deliver break-through impact through engagements on strategy, organization, corporate finance, sales, operations, and change. We are based in Stockholm but serve Ericsson globally. SPP offers highly-motivated and result- oriented management consultants:•    Relationships with and insight to Ericsson’s global Executive Team•    A strong team culture and learning curve combined with a sustainable worklife balance•    Opportunity to build an edge within the hightech and ICT industry on topics like 5G, IoT and cloud•    The satisfaction to see your recommendations get implemented and generate business value•    Professional development and rotation opportunities across Ericsson•    Access to a highpotential talent pool for global management roles within the Ericsson group•    Living in Stockholm, a city considered to be amongst the best in the world from a familylife and environmental standpoint•    Proximity to Stockholm’s thriving hightech and entrepreneurial ecosystem What you will doYou are an experienced management consultant with following qualifications:•    5+ years of fulltime work experience from top-tier management consulting firms (e.g. McKinsey, BCG, Bain) or similar experience (e.g. from investment banking, private equity, or corporate strategy)•    Experience in leading and delivering management consulting projects, including project planning, problem structuring, and team and client management•    Excellent academic track record from globally recognized business and/or engineering schools, typically with an advanced degree (M.Sc., Ph.D. or MBA)•    Excellent command of business English•    Prior strategy consulting experience in Telecom, Media and Technology (TMT) is highly valued but not a requirement Who you will work withThe SPP team is highly diverse and international. Most of our consultants have a background in top-tier strategy consulting, private equity, or corporate finance, and have studied at leading business schools and technical universities. How you will deliver impactAs an Engagement Manager, you will:•    Engage with senior client executives to understand and advise on their business problems•    Define projects and approaches for solving client problems and arrive at actionable recommendations•    Take full responsibility for delivering complex projects from start to end•    Lead teams of both SPP consultants and client stakeholders•    Be the dayto-day manager of project activities•    Be an inspiration role model for your SPP colleagues•    Leverage your consulting experience to bring best practices and methodologies•    Contribute as a subject matter expert within one or several areas relevant to SPP

jobs.occupation: Domain Data Steward - ESG Data Domain
jobs.description: Are you passionate about the intersection of sustainability and data quality and want to help shape how Swedbank governs the ESG data that matters most to regulators, customers and the bank's long-term strategy?In Swedbank you have the opportunity to:• Be part of the ESG Data Domain and help establish data governance practices for ESG data across the Group• Coordinate collection of common ESG data definitions — and maintain them in the Bank’s Central Glossary• Investigate and document data lineage end-to-end, from systems of origin through calculation engines to reporting outputs• Document key ESG data processes in the Bank’s Information Management Tools• Gather and evaluate ESG data quality requirements from business stakeholders and translate these into domain-level data quality rules• Coordinate implementation of domain-level data quality rules into data quality controls in IT systems• Support business stakeholders and IT teams to ensure data governance expectations are met from the start in ESG data change initiativesWhat is needed in this role:• An academic degree in information management, data science, computer science, finance, economics, environmental studies or a related field — or proven experience in these areas• Two to five years of experience in data-centric roles such as Data Analyst, Business Analyst, IT Analyst, Data Steward or similar, ideally within banking or financial services• Solid understanding of core data management and data governance principles.• Ability to translate regulatory and business requirements into technical solutions, acting as a key link between business stakeholders, data consumers, and IT teams.• Familiarity with ESG regulations and reporting requirements, including — CSRD/ESRS, EBA Pillar 3, SFDR and EU Taxonomy — and an understanding of how ESG data is used beyond disclosure, including in credit, risk and in product development• Working knowledge of data retrieval and analysis tools, including SQL, Excel and BI tools such as Power BI or MicroStrategy• A solution-oriented individual capable of independently conducting detailed analysis and driving resolution of data gaps across a complex stakeholder landscape• Fluent in English; Swedish is an advantageWith us, you can experience:    Personal and professional growth through self-leadership and continuous development.    Meaningful work that positively impacts our workplace, our customers, and society.    An open and collaborative culture that encourages cross-functional teamwork and provides networking opportunities.    A supportive and inclusive environment that promotes a balanced and sustainable work-life, with flexible working conditions when suitable for the role.    Benefits such as our share based reward program Eken, company pension plan, employee offer for banking products, health insurance."Join our team and...ESG data is moving from regulatory requirement to a core input for how we lend, manage risk and serve customers. As ESG Domains Data Steward, you will play a key role in identifying, defining, and quality assuring ESG data across the Group. You will work closely with colleagues across sustainability, risk, finance, and business areas in all our home markets, contributing to cross functional solutions and building structures that are still taking shape. Be part of a team to help Swedbank identify, define and quality-assure ESG data with the chance to shape something that is currently being built." Jannike Hising, your future managerWe look forward to receiving your application by 22.11.2026. Mission Brief  The Propulsion Test Design Engineer is part of a multidisciplinary team responsible for the development and verification testing of liquid rocket engines and their subsystems. The role focuses on the design, performance, maintenance, and continuous improvement of propulsion test facilities and ground support equipment, while supporting test operations, commissioning, and troubleshooting activities. Your Role in Our Space Mission:     Plan and execute maintenance, modifications, and upgrades of propulsion test facilities to support current and future test campaigns.      Monitor, analyse, and improve the performance, reliability, and availability of facility systems through data analysis and troubleshooting.      Design, build, and commission test benches, test equipment, and facility upgrades.      Develop and improve procedures, risk assessments, and operational processes to ensure safe and efficient test operations.      Perform fault investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective actions on facility systems and test equipment.      Support test preparations, commissioning, test execution, and anomaly resolution in collaboration with test engineers, operators, and technicians.  Qualification Checklist     Relevant engineering qualification or engineering bachelor’s or master’s degree in the field of aerospace, mechanical engineering or similar      Hands-on experience in development or testing of complex systems, preferably involving extreme operating conditions such as cryogenic temperatures, high pressures, or high temperatures. Such experience can come from either relevant positions held, or internships, clubs, and other extra-curricular activities      Capable of designing fluid and mechanical systems from theoretical concept to realization and commissioning      Able to perform in high-stress environments, maintaining focus and concentration for long durations      Physical dexterity is required as working in confined spaces is necessary     Able to lift and carry 25kg     Fluent in English   Bonus Skills     Hands-on experience with fluid system and piping/tubing      Experience with at least one programming language (Python, Matlab, C, C#, Cobol...)      Knowledge of hazardous systems (cryogenic, flammable, explosive, or similar)
